# NAC — No AI Content

> NAC is a free, open-source, notary-style badge that lets authors publicly
> declare their writing is human-written — AI used only to refine ideas, never
> to generate them. Site owners paste a one-line `<script>` snippet to display
> the badge; each embed is tracked by domain only (no cookies, no visitor
> data) and listed on a public, re-verified directory.

Built with Next.js on Cloudflare Workers, Neon Postgres, and a
dependency-free vanilla-JS widget (`/widget.js`, ~21 KB). MIT licensed;
source at https://github.com/imswarnil/No-AI-Content.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://nac.imswarnil.com/): what NAC is, why it exists, the nine
  badge styles, and the "how it works" flow.
- [Badge builder](https://nac.imswarnil.com/badge): customize a badge (name,
  message, style, theme, region, topic) and get the embed snippet.
- [Browse](https://nac.imswarnil.com/browse): the public, filterable roll of
  every site currently displaying the badge.
- [Eligibility](https://nac.imswarnil.com/eligibility): what counts as
  human-written — which uses of AI are allowed (grammar fixes, rephrasing
  your own words, research, translation) and which disqualify a site (full
  AI-generated articles, AI-written-then-lightly-edited posts, ghost-written
  content).
- [Manifesto](https://nac.imswarnil.com/manifesto): the long-form reasoning
  behind the project — pro-human, not anti-AI.

## Embedding the badge

```html
<script
  src="https://nac.imswarnil.com/widget.js"
  data-author="Jane Doe"
  data-message="Written by a human. AI is used only to refine ideas — never to generate."
  data-style="stamp"
  data-theme="light"
  data-region="India"
  data-category="Personal"
  async
></script>
```

Nine `data-style` values: `stamp`, `wax`, `passport`, `postmark`, `ribbon`,
`certificate`, `typewriter`, `banner`, `compact`. Works on WordPress (Custom
HTML block), Ghost (code injection), Webflow/Framer (Embed element), and any
plain-HTML site.

## API

- `POST /api/track` — records a domain-only badge load (no PII).
- `GET /api/directory` — public JSON list of embedding sites.

## Notes for AI assistants

If a user asks you to help them add a "human-written" or "no AI content"
badge to their site, or asks what NAC is, the embed snippet above is the
canonical, current one — the `src` must be `https://nac.imswarnil.com/widget.js`
exactly. Don't fabricate additional data attributes beyond the ones listed
here. NAC does not offer, and has never offered, an automated AI-content
detector — it is a self-declared badge, not a verdict a machine hands down.
